summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K reporting preliminary Q2 2026 financial results under Korean IFRS. The filing provides consolidated and separate operating revenue, operating income, and profit figures for the quarter and year-to-date, with comparisons to prior periods. No transaction, corporate action, or strategic event is announced. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, with financial data subject to external audit confirmation. There are no deal terms, advisors, or recommendations. The filing serves solely to report operating performance to investors and analysts via an earnings call.
